hints.title: Partition Topologies
hints.text: Three non-overlapping rectangles covering all ones correspond to 6 canonical slice geometries: 3 horizontal strips, 3 vertical strips, or one strip paired with two perpendicular sub-strips.

hints.title: Subgrid Bounding Box Area
hints.text: Define a helper get_area(r1, c1, r2, c2) that computes the minimum bounding box covering all ones within the rectangle [r1..r2] x [c1..c2].

hints.title: Exhaustive Split Enumeration
hints.text: Enumerate all split indices for the 6 structural topologies and minimize the sum of the three bounding box areas.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Exhaustive slice split across small matrix boundaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General exact cover algorithms are overkill when grid cuts are constrained to straight lines.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enumerate the 6 geometric slice configurations systematically.
